habitat: Brusy open subalpine areas; winters in foothills in scrubby areas; field edges; and gardens
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Blue Fronted Redstart (Phoenicurus frontalis) stands out. This species, part of the Muscicapidae family, is a resident of Brusy open subalpine areas; winters in foothills in scrubby areas; field edges; and gardens. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Blue Fronted Redstart is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Blue Fronted Redstart and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
